field.label: Enable Xray
field.help: Enable the Xray-core VLESS+Reality VPN service (xray-core + tun2socks)

field.label: Enable Watchdog
field.help: Automatically restart xray-core and tun2socks if they crash (checked every minute via cron). Writes recovery events to /var/log/xray-watchdog.log.

field.label: Routing strategy
field.help: Order of routing rules (BLOCK / PROXY / DIRECT). Behavior will be documented later.

field.label: Enable BGP
field.help: Enable BIRD (sysrc bird_enable=YES / NO, then service bird start or stop on Apply). After reboot and on Apply, BIRD starts only if at least one Xray tun2socks process is running. BGP peers are configured on the Routing tab.

field.label: Interface WAN4
field.help: FreeBSD device for BIRD WAN4_IF (IPv4). Filled automatically from the WAN / default route on first install; you can override manually. Used when a BGP filter sets Interface to WAN4.

field.label: Interface WAN6
field.help: FreeBSD device for BIRD WAN6_IF (IPv6). Filled automatically from the WAN / default route on first install; you can override manually. Used when a BGP filter sets Interface to WAN6.

field.label: Enable DNStap BGP
field.help: Enable dnstap-bgp: write Unbound dnstap.conf (dnstap-enable yes, socket /var/run/dnstap-bgp/dnstap.sock inside chroot), set dnstap-bgp listen to the matching host path /var/unbound/var/run/dnstap-bgp/dnstap.sock, reload Unbound, then start dnstap-bgp. Disable sets dnstap-enable no and reloads Unbound.

field.label: Auto route
field.help: Automatic interface selection based on minimum latency (default: three polls, 10 minutes between polls).

field.label: Instance IPv4 Weight
field.help: Use instance Weight IPv4 when choosing the active IPv4 tun2socks (at BIRD start and on Auto route). If disabled, IPv4 selection ignores weight.

field.label: Instance IPv6 Weight
field.help: Use instance Weight IPv6 when choosing the active IPv6 tun2socks (at BIRD start and on Auto route). If disabled, IPv6 selection ignores weight.

field.label: Auto route polls
field.help: Number of latency probes per tun2socks interface. The lowest successful time_total is used. Default is 3.

field.label: Auto route interval (minutes)
field.help: Minutes between automatic selection runs. Default is 10.
